prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / style-transfer.
Asset type: one refined logo identity board for Distil. The supplied image is the earlier concept to refine, not a final identity to preserve exactly.
User direction: editorial warmth plus modern AI-powered intelligence. Refine the existing symbol-led approach into a much cleaner, sharper lowercase d and redesign the accompanying lettering to feel contemporary. Deliver ONE clear design, not multiple alternatives.

BACKGROUND: fill EVERY pixel of the full landscape 1536x1024 canvas with opaque warm ivory #F6F3ED. No transparency or alpha holes. This is a flat graphic presentation on a light background. Absolutely no glow, shadows, texture, vignette, lighting effects, dimensionality or gradients.

SYMBOL redesign: a substantial, distinctive, contemporary lowercase d in solid cobalt #315DF5. Use a softly squared near-circular bowl with a generous near-circular counter and a straight vertical ascender on the RIGHT. The ascender has a simple flat horizontal top and no flag, hook, wedge or serif. Stroke widths are substantial and almost uniform with subtle optical correction. Remove the previous diagonal slash/checkmark completely. Instead place ONE clean, short, exactly HORIZONTAL opening at the 9 o'clock position connecting the outer left edge to the inner counter, like a small precisely machined aperture. The aperture is open ivory negative space, with horizontal parallel edges, approximately one sixth of the bowl height wide vertically. It stops at the counter; nothing crosses or fills the counter. The overall silhouette stays recognizably a lowercase d with one quiet aperture. Precision, openness, clarity. Do not add any triangle, tick, diagonal slash, note flag, blue square, central dot, disconnected piece, arrow, funnel, stacked lines or sparkle.

WORDMARK redesign: exact lowercase "distil" (d-i-s-t-i-l, six letters) in solid deep ink #172329. Draw a custom CONTEMPORARY HUMANIST SEMI-SERIF with very low stroke contrast, short subtle flared terminals, clear round counters, substantial strokes, crisp horizontal endings, a compact t, short foot on l, and round i dots. The lettering must be noticeably more modern, open, less formal and less high-contrast than the supplied image. It should sit between a warm editorial serif and a precise modern humanist sans, with only restrained hints of serifs. No hairlines or long triangular serifs, no Times-style letterforms, no elaborate calligraphy. Both i dots ink. Beautiful bespoke letterspacing, natural readable proportions, slightly generous spacing. Sophisticated and approachable.
Hero lockup: symbol at left, wordmark at right. The symbol's total height should be only about 110 percent of the wordmark ascender height, not gigantic. Comfortable gap. Optically centered across upper-middle.

LAYOUT: modest text at top-left "distil / refined identity" in small clean sans. Thin ink separator. One large, crisp hero lockup in upper-middle, lots of light space. Bottom quarter separated by a light thin rule: three small, neatly balanced usage specimens of THE SAME NEW SYMBOL. Left: solid ink symbol alone, caption "Monochrome". Center: ivory symbol centered in flat ink rounded-square app tile, caption "App icon". Right: smaller cobalt symbol plus ink wordmark, caption "Compact". These are applications of one logo, no alternative shapes. Make all silhouettes absolutely identical in the hero and every specimen, merely scaled and recolored.
Only permitted text: "distil / refined identity", "distil", "Monochrome", "App icon", "Compact". No tagline, numbers, added text or color chips. Refine deliberately to feel like a professional design studio's polished identity presentation.
